title: koeleria theodoriana
intro: Koeleria theodoriana, commonly known as Theodor's Koeleria, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is a type of plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Mongolia and China. The health benefits of Koeleria theodoriana include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of the plant include calming the nervous system, improving sleep quality, and reducing stress and anxiety, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils.
